name: Russian Mahjong Khorosho!
original_name: ろしあんマージャン ハラショー!
source:
The male protagonist Hiroyuki lost to an old witch in a mahjong game, as a punishment he was turned into a woman by the witch.

The witch told Hiroyuki if he wanted to turn back into a man, he must come to the witch's mansion and challenge the residents of the mansion.

To get back his male body, Hiroyuki started his mahjong journey to the mansion, until he discovered the true intention of the witch ...
translation:
男主角Hiroyuki在一场麻将对局中输给了老女巫，作为惩罚，被女巫变成了女人。

女巫告诉他，如果想恢复男儿身，就必须来到她的宅邸，挑战住在那里的住客。

为了变回男性，Hiroyuki踏上了前往女巫宅邸的麻将之旅，直到他发现女巫真正的意图…
